name: @busyholm/ui
description: Busyholm UI: tray popover, settings, details window and onboarding pages (ui/dist is copied into app/dist by app/scripts/assemble-frontend.mjs).
devToolsNote: Browser tests and screenshots use playwright-core 1.64.0 and axe-core 4.14.0 from PLAYWRIGHT_PATH / AXE_PATH or a local install (tools/deps.mjs); esbuild 0.28.2 comes from world/art. Nothing is installed by this package.
